description: This Java source file defines the ClassStubber class, a subclass of ASM's ClassVisitor, responsible for generating stub methods for all methods in the classes it visits. It acts as a visitor in bytecode manipulation, wrapping method visiting with additional stub generation logic.

classes.name: ClassStubber
classes.description: A subclass of ASM's ClassVisitor that generates stubs for all methods of visited classes, passing other components unchanged.

methods.name: ClassStubber
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ClassStubber with another ClassVisitor to delegate calls to, setting the ASM API version.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Overrides the method to visit class header information such as version, access flags, name, signature, superclass, and interfaces.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Signals the end of class visit.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Visits annotations on the class, returning an AnnotationVisitor.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visits an attribute of the class.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Visits a method in the class, returning a MethodVisitor wrapped with stub creation logic.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Visits a field declaration in the class.
